stem:
Esha needs a length unit the whole class can share.

Which is suitable as a standard unit?

options.text: Each child's own foot, because it is easy.
The metre, so everyone uses the same agreed length.
A unit that changes every day with mood.
No shared unit is possible for length.

teacher.key_rationale: A standard unit is agreed and does not change with the person. The metre is that. A personal foot is not shared.
